chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Bunan ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both), who said:
I asked him about the sale of walayah (manumission right), is it permissible? He said, 'It is not permissible.'

key_terms.بَيْعُ الْوَلَاءِ: Sale of the right of manumission

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell the right of manumission (wala') in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith from the Chapter of Manumission in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that *al-wala'* (the right of inheritance from a freed slave) is an exclusive attribute of the manumitter and cannot be transferred via sale. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that *wala'* is a distinct legal bond tied to the act of freeing, ensuring the master's financial interest remains secure without being commodified separately.
